publication.author: Felipe Sabino

record.title: Direct EL2 reset avoids the firmware stall
record.method: Ordered UART milestones and post-run integrity
record.observation: One physical confirmation drains storage, enters qualified EL2 reset, reaches a new SPL after 1.084 seconds and shows the ordinary selector. The final reset uses WDOG0 and does not call TF-A reset.
record.limits: One confirmation is not repeated ordinary-restart hand acceptance. The older HVC/PSCI firmware stall is retained. Normal runtime watchdogs remain disabled.
